title: Interpretability, Then What? Editing Machine Learning Models to Reflect Human Knowledge and Values
reasoning: The paper introduces GAM Changer, an interactive system for editing Generalized Additive Models (GAMs). While it discusses aligning models with human values and monitoring fairness to prevent impact disparities, its core contribution is a human-computer interaction tool for model interpretability and editing, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
